# 2024 suspect rate for non-citizens: 3,900, not 5,200 (fixture, side B)

> **FIXTURE — not a real source.** Written for the test suite. The numbers illustrate a structure; they are not evidence about the world.

In the 2024 reporting year, the recorded suspect rate for non-citizens was 3,900 per
100,000 residents of the same group, not 5,200. The 5,200 figure in side A is a
transcription error for the same period.
